title: Summa Contra Gentiles
author: aquinas
attributionNote: The attribution is recorded as the edition and the scholarly consensus give it; where the attribution is disputed, the work says so.
description: Aquinas's argument for the Christian faith addressed to those who do not accept scripture, proceeding by reason where possible. Book I treats God, Book II creation, Book III providence and the end of creatures, Book IV revelation, incarnation and sacraments.
historicalContext: Written in Italy and Paris while Aquinas was teaching, in conversation with Aristotle and with Islamic and Jewish philosophy.
availabilityNote: Streamed from the Christian Classics Ethereal Library at read time. Rickaby's 1905 translation, served by the CCEL. The Latin original is not hosted in this streaming edition.
